author: /root
scope: Frozen private /tmp maintenance runner and plan builder only; no document-body semantic review or source-code storage implementation acceptance.
verdict: counter; do not execute frozen first revision against a repository

findings.statement: Existing output and nonexistent output-parent are rejected only at final receipt write after successful public registry publication and review mutations. Both actual probes exited 1 while entry total changed 1 -> 2 and manifest/shard/control changed. No retained publication lock remained.
findings.requiredFix: Validate owned output location and parent and reserve a new ordinary output fd before any repo mutation; preserve failed/incomplete capture rather than claiming a cross-file transaction.

findings.statement: A review cycle in explicitly supplied edits passes current preflight and is rejected after the registry has published; actual entry total 1 -> 2 despite exit 1. Automatic allReviews membership exemption also defers unexplained review-target drift until post-publication.
findings.requiredFix: Compute and validate the full edited review graph/topological order and planned transitive closure before writer; permit only exact explicitly edited child nodes and their planned pin dependencies, not every review file.

findings.statement: A made-up boolean evidence.nonAuthorReviewer=true in a replacement binding is enough to upgrade an arbitrary docs/ops/a.md to reviewed/compliant. Actual probe exited 0 with no independent report file, report hash or approved fixed body. Whole-file reviewEdits can also replace unrelated entries/history/top-level fields. This is a guard-adversarial plan counter, not a claim that root supplied such a plan.
findings.requiredFix: Restrict this maintenance intake to fixed approved S03/S04 path/body/report SHA triplets, verify actual report bytes and identity/scope fields, enforce same entry identity and exact binding location, preserve every other entry and top-level native/history field, and limit superseded bindings to append-only explicit known objects.

findings.statement: After prepublish input recheck a separately owned watcher observed the real public-writer lock and replaced docs/ops/a.md. Runner exited 0 and pinned this new unreviewed hash 02abd24e... although its plan fixed the original 9d0cc50e... . A string allowedPinDeltas reason silently authorizes any later bytes.
findings.requiredFix: Each non-storage target pin must equal its exact planned accepted after SHA; storage pins must equal the exact published loadedSource bytes; child review pins must equal exact bytes prepared/formatted by this run. Reject unexpected bytes instead of refreshing. Revalidate fixed body and receipt SHA after publication and before writing review bytes. State the non-transaction boundary and retain failure evidence.

positiveObservations.statement: Real public loader/writer in one process accepts an explicit pending addition. Existing two native entries remained equal, new entry stays partial-review-unknown/needs-migration, total 2 -> 3. This confirms no stub replaced the API.

Frozen runner obtains loadedSource directly from public loadDocumentRegistry and uses the branded object in the same process. Existing structuralRoots are not directly modified by this runner. Per-review formatting precedes parent hashing under the topological loop. These correct pieces do not close the reported counters.

limits: Only the frozen first /tmp revisions identified by their SHA were tested; live root edits were not followed.

Owned /tmp git fixtures and real public API copied from author commit db814e3cfecc51b8226453f6930b8ec4c22a0743 were used. No repository files, task cards, central JSON or shared /tmp author scripts were edited.
No product, runtime, E2E, visual, coverage, historical receipt execution, global gate or full semantic credit is granted.
The output failure and cycle probes demonstrate partial mutation, not corruption of native storage or a public-writer locking counter.

The race probe deliberately supplies a concurrent direct edit outside the registry protocol; it demonstrates that the maintenance pin guard should reject it, not that a registry lock must prevent arbitrary filesystem edits.

The plan builder was fully read; its forwarding of arbitrary registryUpdates/reviewEdits does not supply the missing authority, preservation or exact-sha checks. The real negative probes execute the frozen runner with explicit plans, not the Python builder.
